verdict.rationale: Mastra documents its own cost tracking across agent runs, a per-model-call timeline, routing to 90+ providers, and support for your own private model gateways, so it covers the core of both halves of the story. All of this comes only from marketing-level vendor claims, and it is not shown how costs break down. Missing for 10: explicit bring-your-own API key or subscription documentation, token-usage reporting, cost aggregation per model or per conversation/thread, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I bring my own API keys or subscriptions and can see token usage and cost per model or per conversation

citations.quote: Track latency, cost, model calls, and tool usage across every production agent run.
Inspect every model call, tool call, and handoff from one searchable timeline.
Mastra's model routing connects to 90+ providers through one standard interface.
users can only select models from your own gateways
